newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Hun Sen says royalist intelligence official dead.
newsitem.headline: Hun Sen says royalist intelligence official dead.

text.p: Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen on Monday confirmed the killing of a senior intelligence officer loyal to the ousted first prime minister.
Hun Sen said Chao Sambath was killed during fighting, but did not say where or when he died. It was the first official confirmation of the officer's death.
"Chao Sambath was killed. He died during the fighting," Hun Sen said in a speech to villagers and reporters in Kampong Thom province, north of Phnom Penh.

Chao Sambath was one of four senior royalists identified by Hun Sen as responsible for two days of fighting in the Cambodian capital. Hun Sen ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh last week as his forces pushed Ranariddh's men out of the city.

One of the three other royalists identified by Hun Sen, Secretary of State for Interior Ho Sok, was shot dead by armed men after he was arrested on July 7, government officials said. Human rights groups have called the killing an execution.

Dozens of members of Ranariddh's party and his supporters fled Cambodia after his ouster, and the London-based human rights group Amnesty International has expressed grave fears for the safety of hundreds of royalist soldiers and supporters captured by Hun Sen's forces.
